Members

COPY_PITCH

bytesPerRow alignment required by copyTextureToBuffer.

widgets

Live widget records — id → { widget, canvas, manual, active, last, timer }.

devicePromise

The worker's own shared GPUDevice — one device serves every canvas.

moduleInit

wasm-pack init is not reentrant-safe: __wbg_init reads the module-level wasm binding, then awaits instantiate — a concurrent second call re-instantiates and swaps the heap under live widgets (RefCell flags read garbage → 'gpu slot poisoned'). Memoize per artifact URL so concurrent mounts share one instantiation.

initModule

initModule — fetch + instantiate the artifact glue once per URL.

getDevice

Request the worker-side device once; clears on loss so mounts re-request.

stop

Stop a record's pump loop.

  • @param rec The widget record.

pump

The worker-side render pump — owns widget.frame(dt) for RAF-driven kinds. A wasm-boundary throw or a false return disarms the pump and reports dead so the bridge can fall back.

  • @param rec The widget record.

probeFrame

probeFrame — the draw-text overlay's self-verify, worker-side: jump the stagger to end state, read the canvas texture back through the worker's device, count painted pixels.

  • @param rec The widget record.
  • @param ms The probe timestamp (past the last char's end).
  • @returns Painted coverage ratio 0..1, or -1 on any readback failure.

mount

mount — import the artifact, instantiate the widget, init it on the transferred OffscreenCanvas. Manual records skip the pump — their caller paces frame messages itself.
